comment: Gate-scan hits (scripts/discover-gate-modules.mjs) that classifyAuthorityPaths deliberately does not classify. Each needs a reason; the coverage test fails on a stale entry or a new unexcluded hit.

exclusions.src/agentRoles/brief.ts: Prompt text only: tells helpers to submit propose-only Agent Asks; enforces nothing.
exclusions.src/clarify/handoff.ts: Builds a propose-only Agent Ask payload (requested_authority: propose); grants and enforces nothing.
exclusions.src/cli.ts: Command wiring; the scan hit is an option description and a spend-exit-code import. Gates live in the classified modules it calls.
exclusions.src/commands/productionLiveness.ts: Read-only liveness report that calls assessSpendRisk; enforcement stays in classified src/spend/.
exclusions.src/commands/qa.ts: Operator-run CLI wrapper that only imports verdict result types; review proof is enforced in classified src/qa/.
exclusions.src/coordinator/sources.ts: Read-only gh query that lists existing independent-review marker comments; never records or checks a verdict.
exclusions.src/db/repositories.ts: Persistence only: createId for stored approval-gate rows; the gate decision lives in classified modules.
exclusions.src/recurring/scheduler.ts: Submits its own scheduled Agent Ask as a request; settlement and authority stay in classified src/ask/.
exclusions.src/sessions/actionBrief.ts: Brief text instructing sessions to file propose-only Asks; enforces nothing.
exclusions.src/sessions/sessionProposals.ts: Prompt text pointing sessions at the propose-only Ask path; enforces nothing.
exclusions.src/stewardship/prBlastRadius.ts: Emits a propose-only Agent Ask recommending review scope; the merge guard itself is classified src/decisions/.
exclusions.src/utils/id.ts: Generic id generator whose type union names approvalGate; no gate logic.
